conventions.name: figure-declares-meta
conventions.description: Every figure exports `meta: FigureMeta` (title, one-sentence claim, status, sources). TypeScript checks the fields: a measured figure must name its sources.

conventions.name: figure-declares-tips
conventions.description: Every figure exports `tips: FigureTips` so each non-obvious part a stranger might not know has a plain explanation behind a hover or focus.

conventions.name: figure-exports-component
conventions.description: A figure file exports one component named after the file (polling-toy.tsx exports PollingToy).

conventions.name: figure-renders-in-a-plate
conventions.description: Figures render inside FigurePlate, which gives them the frame, head, caption, tips, expand and stable layout.

conventions.name: figure-keeps-heavy-libraries-out
conventions.description: Ordinary figures stay light: three.js, react-three-fiber and mermaid belong in a separate, lazily loaded *.webgl.tsx or *.diagram.tsx file.
